preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 100000 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements N is between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A_i <= 1000000000 for A_i in A_values)
preconditions.description: Each element A_i in the sequence is between 1 and 1000000000.
The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 2000000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N - 1 for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains N-1 space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) for x in output_line.split() for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is non-negative.
